entries.name: Cross-Country
entries.blurb: Six miles before most people are awake.
entries.tryoutText: Made the cross-country team. First practice was at six in the morning.
entries.cutText: Didn't make the cross-country squad by about ninety seconds.
entries.joinText: Joined the cross-country team. First practice was at six in the morning.
entries.leaveText: Stopped running cross-country. Slept in for the first time since September.

entries.name: Basketball
entries.blurb: Practice every night, games on Fridays.
entries.tryoutText: Made the basketball team. Practice every night, games on Fridays.
entries.cutText: Cut from basketball on the second day. The list was on the gym door.
entries.joinText: Made the basketball team. Practice every night, games on Fridays.

entries.name: Football
entries.blurb: Two-a-days in August. Everyone knows you by October.
entries.tryoutText: Made the football team. Two-a-days started in August.
entries.cutText: Cut from football. The coach said to come back a stone heavier.
entries.joinText: Made the football team. Two-a-days started in August.
entries.leaveText: Quit football. The coach didn't take it well.

entries.name: Swim Team
entries.blurb: Chlorine in everything you own.
entries.costSource: swim team fees and a season of goggles
entries.tryoutText: Made the swim team. Everything you own smells like chlorine now.
entries.cutText: Missed the swim team's qualifying time by four seconds.
entries.joinText: Joined the swim team. Everything you own smells like chlorine now.

entries.name: Soccer
entries.blurb: Saturday mornings, every Saturday, all year.
entries.costSource: league registration and a pair of cleats
entries.tryoutText: Made the soccer team. Games are Saturday mornings, every Saturday.
entries.cutText: Didn't make the soccer team. Somebody's dad read the list out.
entries.joinText: Signed up for soccer. Games are Saturday mornings, every Saturday.

entries.name: Wrestling
entries.blurb: Cutting weight is a normal Tuesday.
entries.tryoutText: Made the wrestling team. Cutting weight turned out to be most of it.
entries.cutText: Didn't make weight for wrestling, and that was that.
entries.joinText: Joined the wrestling team. Cutting weight turned out to be most of it.
entries.leaveText: Quit wrestling and ate an entire pizza.

entries.name: Track & Field
entries.blurb: Spring season. Bus rides and a stopwatch.
entries.tryoutText: Made the track team. Spring meets, long bus rides, one stopwatch.
entries.cutText: Didn't make the track team. The times were posted in the hallway.
entries.joinText: Went out for track. Spring meets, long bus rides, one stopwatch.

entries.name: Marching Band
entries.blurb: Field practice in full uniform in September heat.
entries.costSource: a rented clarinet at $18 a month
entries.joinText: Joined marching band. Mom rented an instrument at $18 a month.
entries.leaveText: Turned in the rented instrument and quit band.

entries.name: School Play
entries.blurb: Six quiet weeks, then three of everything at once.
entries.tryoutText: Got cast in the school play. Rehearsals run late through opening night.
entries.cutText: Auditioned for the school play and got a thank-you and a closed door.
entries.joinText: Got cast in the school play. Rehearsals run late through opening night.
entries.leaveText: Dropped out of the school play.

entries.name: Choir
entries.blurb: Two concerts a year and a lot of standing on risers.
entries.joinText: Joined choir. Two concerts a year and a great deal of standing on risers.

entries.name: Art Club
entries.blurb: Turpentine, and nobody hurrying you along.
entries.joinText: Joined art club. Thursdays in a room that smells like turpentine.

entries.name: Jazz Band
entries.blurb: Before school, for people who already play.
entries.tryoutText: Got into jazz band. Rehearsals before school, twice a week.
entries.cutText: Auditioned for jazz band and was asked to try again next year.
entries.joinText: Got into jazz band. Rehearsals before school, twice a week.

entries.name: Chess Club
entries.blurb: Two hours a week and a slow, permanent improvement.
entries.joinText: Joined chess club. Two hours a week in the library.

entries.name: Science Olympiad
entries.blurb: Regionals in March. Somebody's dad drives.
entries.costSource: Science Olympiad registration, covered by the booster club
entries.joinText: Joined Science Olympiad. Registration was $25 and the booster club paid it.

entries.name: Debate Team
entries.blurb: Weekend tournaments in other schools' cafeterias.
entries.tryoutText: Made the debate team. Tournaments are weekends, in other schools' cafeterias.
entries.cutText: Didn't make the debate team. You were told your rebuttals were thin.
entries.joinText: Joined the debate team. Tournaments are weekends, in other schools' cafeterias.

entries.name: Robotics
entries.blurb: Solder, and a competition in April.
entries.costSource: robotics team parts and entry fees
entries.joinText: Joined the robotics team. Every weekend in a room that smells like solder.

entries.name: Math Team
entries.blurb: Before school. Nobody knows it exists.
entries.joinText: Joined the math team. Meets before school; nobody else knows it exists.

entries.name: Yearbook
entries.blurb: Deadlines in February that nobody warned you about.
entries.joinText: Joined yearbook staff. The February deadline is the whole year.

entries.name: Student Council
entries.blurb: You have to be elected. You can lose.
entries.tryoutText: Won a seat on student council by eleven votes.
entries.cutText: Ran for student council and lost. The posters stayed up for a week.
entries.joinText: Won a seat on student council.

entries.name: School Paper
entries.blurb: A deadline every two weeks, forever.
entries.joinText: Joined the school paper. A deadline every two weeks, forever.

entries.name: Volunteering
entries.blurb: Saturday mornings at the food bank.
entries.joinText: Started volunteering Saturday mornings at the food bank.

entries.name: Scouts
entries.blurb: Camping trips and a shirt covered in patches.
entries.costSource: scout dues and a uniform shirt
entries.joinText: Joined scouts. Dues were $70 and the shirt came covered in space for patches.

entries.name: Drama Club
entries.blurb: Improv games in a carpeted room, twice a week.
entries.joinText: Joined drama club. Improv games in a carpeted room, twice a week.

entries.name: Reading Club
entries.blurb: Tuesdays in the library, one box of paperbacks.
entries.joinText: Joined the reading club. Tuesdays in the library, one box of donated paperbacks.
entries.leaveText: Stopped going to the reading club.

entries.name: Community Club
entries.blurb: A room at lunch, no explaining required.
entries.joinText: Started going to the club that meets at lunch. Easiest room in the building.
entries.leaveText: Stopped going to the lunchtime club.

entries.name: Rec League
entries.blurb: A Sunday league. Somebody always brings oranges.
entries.joinText: Signed up for a Sunday rec league. The shirts have a plumber's name on them.
entries.leaveText: Stopped turning up to the rec league. Somebody else got your shirt.

entries.name: Running Club
entries.blurb: Tuesday nights, and a long one on Sundays.
entries.joinText: Joined a running club. Friendlier than you expected, and faster.
entries.leaveText: Stopped going to running club. The shoes are still by the door.

entries.name: Community Choir
entries.blurb: Tuesdays in a church hall. Nobody checks.
entries.joinText: Joined a community choir. They put you wherever they were short.
entries.leaveText: Left the choir. You still sing the harmony in the car.

entries.name: Community Theater
entries.blurb: Two shows a year and a set nobody finishes.
entries.tryoutText: Got a part in the community theater's spring show. A real one, with lines.
entries.cutText: Auditioned for the community theater and got a very kind email.
entries.joinText: Got a part in the community theater's spring show. A real one, with lines.
entries.leaveText: Stepped back from the theater. They still email you about the raffle.

entries.name: Band
entries.blurb: Four people, one garage, almost no gigs.
entries.joinText: Started playing in a band with some people you half knew. You aren't good.
entries.leaveText: The band stopped. Nobody said so; the garage just filled up with bikes.

entries.name: Evening Class
entries.blurb: One night a week at the community college.
entries.joinText: Signed up for an evening class. Everybody in it was there for a different reason.
entries.leaveText: Finished the evening class and didn't sign up for the next one.

entries.name: Book Club
entries.blurb: One book a month, mostly read.
entries.joinText: Joined a book club. About half of them finish the book.
entries.leaveText: Quietly stopped going to book club.

entries.name: Quiz Team
entries.blurb: Tuesday trivia at a bar, the same four people.
entries.joinText: Got talked into a quiz team. You turned out to be the one who knows rivers.
entries.leaveText: The quiz team broke up. Nobody knows who has the trophy.

entries.name: Volunteering
entries.blurb: A food bank, Saturday mornings.
entries.joinText: Started volunteering at the food bank on Saturday mornings.
entries.leaveText: Stopped volunteering at the food bank. You still drive past it.

entries.name: Community Garden
entries.blurb: A plot, a hose, and opinions about tomatoes.
entries.costSource: a plot at the community garden
entries.joinText: Took a plot at the community garden. The man next door has thoughts.
entries.leaveText: Gave up the garden plot. Somebody on the waiting list was thrilled.
